_doc: Whitelisted evidence-check violations (tools/evidence_check.py; docs/RULES.md R-AUD-05), 2026-10-29. Each entry: the most violations allowed for one category and school, and why they cannot be fixed in this build. A count above max fails the check and holds the release. Lower the counts as the gaps are fixed; never raise one without a reason.

cmu.why: CMU's site collection gives these advising contexts (source_advising_context: MLD alumni index, CSD profiles, SCS thesis reports, KiltHub thesis records) as bare URLs with no sha256 and no quote (6,236 relations; 2,411 without a hash, 3,814 with a hash but no quote, 11 with no source); the pages were never captured with a quote. Fix: re-capture the cited pages and cut the student's line as the quote.

epfl.why: EPFL's site collection kept the sha256 of each capture (EDIC student lists and published-theses pages, Infoscience OAI records, lab pages) but no quote; the capture bodies sat under /n/fs/similarity, which was removed in the 2026-10-28 migration. Fix: re-fetch the archived captures by URL, check the sha256, and cut the student's line as the quote.

mit.why: MIT's site collection cites DSpace item API records through a metadata snapshot (repository-items.json.gz, no sha256 of the response) for academic_advising, and CSAIL group pages with a sha256 but no quote for direct_lab_membership. Fix: hash the DSpace item responses and quote the advisor field; cut the member's line from the CSAIL group captures.

cmu.why: A byline link carries the student's roster source (relation_source); these links belong to students every one of whose relations is one of the whitelisted student_relation sources above, so the link carries the best source there is (url, and a sha256 where one exists) but no quote. They clear when those relations do.
